scope: Topology-resolved standard SAL control for Lighting, Trigger Control, and Enable Control

grounding.finding: The retained native C-Gate NET PINGU capture establishes the outbound point-to-point-to-multipoint source-route envelope: destination type 0x03, first bridge, 0x09 for one hop, then the target application and SAL bytes. Published C-Bus routing limits this envelope to one through six bridges.

grounding.evidence: testdata/vectors/encode.jsonl direct Lighting, Trigger, and Enable cases
grounding.finding: The existing direct vectors establish the standard SAL payloads without changing their application, group, selector, variable, value, ramp-rate, or checksum rules. Routed support composes those retained payloads with the already implemented PPM source-route envelope.

The shared transport appends one independently allocated PCI confirmation character after the checksummed C-Bus packet. Routed application control uses the no-retry allocation and accepts only that exact character; unrelated direct traffic and Reply Network CAL packets continue through the shared reader.

claimed_behavior: LIGHTING ON, OFF, RAMP, STOP/TERMINATERAMP and their bare or DO aliases use the retained standard Lighting SAL through a database-resolved one-to-six-bridge route.
TRIGGER EVENT and INDICATORKILL use the retained application-202 SAL through the same route envelope.
ENABLE SET uses the retained application-203 network-variable SAL through the same route envelope.
Every routed command is sent once, waits for its exact PCI confirmation, and generation-guards only target-network cache/event changes.
acceptance: Six exact one/six-bridge encode vectors pin all three supported application families.
Transport regressions pin exact confirmation matching, invalid-route preflight, zero replay after a lost confirmation, and direct lighting fanout while a routed send is pending.
Service and real-daemon regressions pin command aliases, target-network-only cache changes, unsupported-route/application refusal before I/O, MQTT continuity, and one shared PCI connection.
limits: A positive PCI confirmation proves interface acceptance only. No remote application-level acknowledgement, Reply Network SAL observation, lighting level readback, controller action, timing, or persistence is claimed.
Routed status requests are not issued because no retained remote status-reply contract is used by this slice.
Dynamic labels, named scenes, clocks, specialist applications, and Enable REMOVE are outside routed physical application control. ENABLE REMOVE remains a local saved-value operation.
